arStrings.szText: {c_important}Rampage{/c} deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage. Each enemy or demon killed by {c_important}Rampage{/c} increases the size of the brute and its smashes by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%|]{/c}.
